steps.title: 極數與轉速：模型與設計
steps.titleEn: Poles and speed: model and design
steps.objective: 針對「極數與轉速」建立可重算、可檢查的工程紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a reproducible, reviewable engineering record for poles and speed.
steps.instruction: 先觀看師傅示意，標出「極數與轉速」的輸入、輸出及量測基準，再在學徒工作台排列對應元件或資料流。同步轉速由頻率與極數共同決定。 在離線草圖或試算表建立基準與擾動兩種情境，寫出因果預測；用「比較二極與四極的轉速表。」規劃如何反駁模型。把未知參數、單位與邊界記錄在學習筆記。
steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor diagram, identify inputs, outputs and references for poles and speed, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Frequency and pole count jointly determine synchronous speed. Build baseline and perturbed cases offline and predict causality. Plan a falsification using: Compare two- and four-pole speed tables. Record unknown parameters, units and boundaries in your learning notes.
steps.observation: 比較二極與四極的轉速表。
steps.observationEn: Compare two- and four-pole speed tables.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：只要名義額定值相同，就可略過「極數與轉速」的驗證。 應先核對量測基準、模型邊界及競爭失效原因。
steps.failureEn: Common mistake: Equal nominal ratings justify skipping poles and speed verification. Check references, model boundaries and competing failure causes first.
steps.check: 提交「極數與轉速」的兩情境模型、單位表及可反駁預測；說明「比較二極與四極的轉速表。」如何區分情境。
steps.checkEn: Submit a two-case model, units and a falsifiable prediction for poles and speed; explain how the proposed check distinguishes cases.

knowledge.title: 本單元機制
knowledge.text: 同步轉速由頻率與極數共同決定。
knowledge.textEn: Frequency and pole count jointly determine synchronous speed.

knowledge.title: 可區分原因的證據
knowledge.text: 比較二極與四極的轉速表。 必須保留基準、單位及不確定度，未有實測資料時只做假想案例判讀。
knowledge.textEn: Compare two- and four-pole speed tables. Retain references, units and uncertainty; without measured data, interpret hypothetical cases only.

knowledge.title: 本課量化連結
knowledge.text: 教學假設二極同步機接 60 Hz：n=120f/p=3600 rpm；若輸出 100 MW、效率 98%，輸入 102.041 MW、損失 2.041 MW。效率為假設且未含汽輪機熱效率。
knowledge.textEn: Assume a two-pole synchronous machine at 60 Hz: n=120f/p=3600 rpm. At 100 MW output and assumed 98% efficiency, input is 102.041 MW and loss 2.041 MW; turbine thermal efficiency is excluded.

quiz.question: 審查「極數與轉速」時，哪個判斷或驗證方法成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which claim or check is justified for poles and speed?
options: 同步轉速由頻率與極數共同決定。
只要名義額定值相同，就可略過「極數與轉速」的驗證。
只調整「極數與轉速」的顯示結果吻合，便可當作獨立量測證據。
optionsEn: Frequency and pole count jointly determine synchronous speed.
Equal nominal ratings justify skipping poles and speed verification.
Tuning the displayed poles and speed result to match counts as independent measurement evidence.
quiz.explanation: 同步轉速由頻率與極數共同決定。 比較二極與四極的轉速表。
quiz.explanationEn: Frequency and pole count jointly determine synchronous speed. Compare two- and four-pole speed tables.

steps.title: 極數與轉速：量測與判讀

Compare the result against: Frequency and pole count jointly determine synchronous speed. List at least two competing causes and select an additional discriminating measurement. steps.failureEn: Common mistake: Equal nominal ratings justify skipping poles and speed verification. Check references, model boundaries and competing failure causes first.
